newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK, China team up to fight commercial crime.
newsitem.headline: HK, China team up to fight commercial crime.

text.p: Top law enforcement officials in Hong Kong and China agreed on Tuesday to work together to crack down on commercial crime, the government said.

Cross-border differences in legal and banking systems and rapid economic development in China in recent years have led to growing commercial fraud, the statement quoted Hong Kong's commissioner of police, Eddie Hui, as saying.
After a meeting in Hong Kong with Zhu Entao, head of China's National Central Bureau of Interpol, Hui said both sides agreed more cooperation was needed to check commercial fraud.
The meeting also focused on illegal mainland immigrants in Hong Kong and seizure of dangerous drugs, the statement said.
Hong Kong, a British colony for over a century and a half, reverts to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997.
